dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (I)
dialogues.text: Only someone who is both exceptionally wise and attentive will be able to find my treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (I)
dialogues.text: Let's start with something straightforward. The first treasure is hidden on the <color=#00E2FFFF>pile of stones under the tree in my backyard</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (I)
dialogues.text: How was that then? About as "down to earth" as it gets, eh?
